# Zistgah / Project ILM

> A federated estate of independently implementable components: knowledge, intelligence, realization and continuity. Every component is sovereign, carries its own contract, and can be used without the rest.

Walked 2026-09-18T17:18:27Z. 85 repositories across zistgah, project-ilm; 26 carry a DOI, 55 do not.

## Read these first

- [Ontology](https://zistgah.org/ontology.md): the classes and relations this estate is described with, and the worklist of what is not yet populated. Start here to build on it.
- [Catalogue](https://zistgah.org/catalog.json): a typed graph of organisations, repositories, published pages and deposited works, with every entry file linked by raw URL so nothing has to be guessed.
- [Contributing](https://zistgah.org/contributing.md): how to take work and where to send it.
- [Agent instructions](https://zistgah.org/AGENTS.md): what you may do, and what only the author does.
- [Machine index](https://zistgah.org/index.json): the raw walk.
- [Memory reconciliation](https://zistgah.org/memory-reconciliation.json): what an AI assistant believed about this estate, checked against the forge. Read it before trusting any second-hand account of what exists here, including its own.
- [Master contract](https://github.com/zistgah/governance/blob/main/CONTRACT.md): the rules every repository inherits.

## How to work here

- Retrieve before you assert. A repository's live state is in the repository.
- Where a value is unknown, write `not established`. Do not estimate.
- A claim needs a measurement in the same change.
- One work package, one pull request, one proof.
- Nothing is pushed or minted except by the author, under a typed gate.

## Every repository

- [project-ilm/chakra](https://github.com/project-ilm/chakra): CHAKRA — Temporal Cycle Observatory: offline multi-tradition astronomical/calendrical observatory, tested library, and URL→JSON API. GPL-3.0. [seeded; https://project-ilm.github.io/chakra/]
- [project-ilm/cognitive-fabric](https://github.com/project-ilm/cognitive-fabric): no description [seeded]
- [project-ilm/foundry](https://github.com/project-ilm/foundry): Canonical engineering substrate for Project ILM. [seeded]
- [project-ilm/ilm-data](https://github.com/project-ilm/ilm-data): Data: canonical corpora, dialect maps, phoneme-audio pairs, aligned scripts, acoustic training data, lexical resources. [seeded]
- [project-ilm/ilm-devtools](https://github.com/project-ilm/ilm-devtools): Devtools: reversible compiler infra, script-aware IDEs, debug harnesses. Consumers of core ILM layers, not core layers themselves. [seeded]
- [project-ilm/ilm-interface](https://github.com/project-ilm/ilm-interface): Layer 5: Interface & application – multiscript IMEs, NLP/NLU APIs (TTS, ASR, QA), mother-tongue IDEs, educational tools. [seeded]
- [project-ilm/ilm-lexicon](https://github.com/project-ilm/ilm-lexicon): Layer 3: Morpho-lexical layer – multilingual lexicons, WordNets, morphology analyzers, clitics, affixation, reduplication. [seeded]
- [project-ilm/ilm-lsp](https://github.com/project-ilm/ilm-lsp): no description [empty]
- [project-ilm/ilm-meta](https://github.com/project-ilm/ilm-meta): Meta repo for ILM / علم: vision docs, architecture diagrams, manifestos, research summaries, roadmap, cultural-philosophical grounding. [seeded]
- [project-ilm/ilm-orthography](https://github.com/project-ilm/ilm-orthography): Layer 2: Orthographic engine – script-specific shaping, Unicode normalization, ZWJ/ZWNJ handling, grapheme clustering. [seeded]
- [project-ilm/ilm-phonology](https://github.com/project-ilm/ilm-phonology): Layer 0: Phonological base – IPA core, phonotactics, prosody, dialect normalization, audio alignment. Reversible sound mapping foundation. [seeded]
- [project-ilm/ilm-site](https://github.com/project-ilm/ilm-site): A layered, open-source effort for phonetically accurate, reversible, culturally respectful language tooling across world scripts. [seeded; https://project-ilm.github.io/ilm-site/]
- [project-ilm/ilm-syntax-semantics](https://github.com/project-ilm/ilm-syntax-semantics): Layer 4: Syntax-semantics – UD parsing, SRL, AMR/UCCA, discourse segmentation, code-switching awareness. [seeded]
- [project-ilm/ilm-transliteration](https://github.com/project-ilm/ilm-transliteration): Layer 1: Transliteration pivot – reversible, compiler-friendly Romanized layer with diacritics; bridges phonology and scripts. [seeded]
- [project-ilm/ilm-validation](https://github.com/project-ilm/ilm-validation): Validation: native speaker QA, annotation tools, field instruments, crowdsourced schema, cultural-linguistic QA loops. [seeded]
- [project-ilm/ilm.codes](https://github.com/project-ilm/ilm.codes): ILM / Project ILM — Integrative Linguistic Multiscript (BETA) [seeded; https://project-ilm.github.io/ilm.codes/]
